title: Gradum Server Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Gradum embedded HTTP server (~/.gradum/settings.json)

$schema.description: JSON Schema location for editor autocompletion

ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the Ollama provider

ollama.apiKey.description: API key override for the Ollama provider

ollama.allowRemote.description: Allow the Ollama provider to dial non-localhost base URLs

lmstudio.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the LM Studio provider

lmstudio.apiKey.description: API key override for the LM Studio provider

lmstudio.allowRemote.description: Allow the LM Studio provider to dial non-localhost base URLs

zhipu.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the Zhipu BigModel provider

zhipu.apiKey.description: API key override for the Zhipu BigModel provider

zhipu.allowRemote.description: Allow the Zhipu provider to dial non-localhost base URLs

deepseek.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the DeepSeek provider

deepseek.apiKey.description: API key override for the DeepSeek provider

deepseek.allowRemote.description: Allow the DeepSeek provider to dial non-localhost base URLs

minimax.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the MiniMax provider

minimax.apiKey.description: API key override for the MiniMax provider

minimax.allowRemote.description: Allow the MiniMax provider to dial non-localhost base URLs

server.title: Server Binding Configuration
server.description: Network binding settings for the HTTP server

host.description: Host address to bind (use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces)

autoDetectPort.description: Automatically find an available port starting from 'port'

apiKeyFile.description: Absolute path to a plain-text file listing the default API key for hosted providers (keeps the secret out of this file). Only the first non-blank line is used; must not be a relative path or '~' shorthand.

llm.title: Default LLM Configuration
llm.description: Server-wide defaults used when the plugin request doesn't specify them

baseUrl.description: Default base URL for the LLM provider

model.description: Default model name to use (empty string = use first discovered available model)

keepAliveMinutes.description: Server-wide default (in minutes) for how long the local Ollama model stays loaded after a request. A positive value keeps it resident for that many minutes, -1 keeps it loaded until the server stops, 0 leaves Ollama's own default. Used only when the plugin request doesn't specify keepAliveMinutes.

commandFilter.title: Command Filter Rules
commandFilter.description: Configures the command safety filter (dangerous blacklist, protected paths). Each field present replaces its built-in default wholesale; absent fields keep the default. The filtering logic itself (dd/rm/chmod analysis) is not configurable.

blockedExecutables.description: Always-on blacklist of dangerous executables that may never run.

protectedPaths.title: Protected Paths
protectedPaths.description: Filesystem paths that destructive operations (rm, recursive chmod, file writes) must never touch.

systemPrefixes.description: System root prefixes that are always protected.

protectedHomeSubdirectories.description: Home subdirectories that are always protected (secrets, credentials).

safePathPrefixes.description: Scratch directories LLM-driven file ops are always allowed to touch regardless of project root.

exactProtectedPaths.description: Bare paths that are always protected (e.g. '/', '/dev').
